data.name: Santa Monica & Venice Beach Bike Tour
data.short_name: LA: Santa Monica & Venice Beach Bike Tour
data.description:
Enjoy the best of Los Angeles with this two hour guided bike tour that begins in Santa Monica near the famous Santa Monica Pier! Take in the ocean breezes, visit the historic Venice Canals, ride through Marina del Rey, take pictures with the Art Walls, and explore Muscle Beach. The sunny California weather makes this tour a fun and beautiful experience for culture enthusiasts and history buffs. Our guides will provide you with fun facts, surprising secrets, and photo opportunities while you soak in the beauty of Santa Monica and Venice Beach. Upgrade your tour to an electric bike for an easier ride!

This guided tour takes about 3 hours and is perfect for families, friend groups, couples, and solo riders! Get the local feel while you learn on this relaxed ride! Attachments like tag-a-longs and trailers are not permitted on this tour.
data.cancellation_notes:
**Bike Tour Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your rental.  

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the rental, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
data.booking_notes:
PICK UP LOCATION :

1431 Ocean Ave
Santa Monica, CA 90401

This tour departs at 10AM. Please plan to arrive 15 minutes early as the tour does leave on time. Let our team know if you are running late. 

Our Store Hours are: 
April - October: 9AM - 7PM
November - March: 9AM - 5PM

Please bring along a valid form of identification and a credit card with you, as these will be needed for security upon check-in for your rentals. Your outfit should be seasonally suitable; we also suggest that you dress in something comfy, not too loose, and closed-toe shoes. Don't forget a proper ID and your camera!

For any questions, please feel free to reach our team at 310-879-5656. We'll see you soon!


**Know Before You Go:**

- We do not allow child attachments on bike tours for safety reasons
- Any riders under 18 years of age must have an adult present to check in and sign the waiver form on their behalf. We require a valid identity card upon check in.
- For all our riders' safety, we are not able to accommodate any riders who are 300 pounds and over as this exceeds the weight limit the manufacturer has advised for the bike's build. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we do prioritize your safety during the ride. 
-Electric bikes are available for riders 13+

If anything from the list above concerns you or any members of your party, please feel free to reach out to our team by responding to this email. We will get back to you as soon as we can!
